name: Charmed
source:
Once upon a time, there was a young man with a positive outlook on life and an empty wallet... This is the beginning of his story—one of struggle, change, and unexpected opportunities.

[From [url=https://immoralstudios.itch.io/charmed]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
从前，有一个年轻人，他有着积极的人生观，但钱包却空空如也……这就是他故事的开始——一个充满奋斗、变化和意外机遇的故事。

[来自[url=https://immoralstudios.itch.io/charmed]Itch.io[/url]]
